claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b071] Batch b071 covers lines 186-267 (sections 5, 5.1-5.4, 6, 7) of results/55maps-cross-track-comparison/report.md. Scope decisions applied throughout: (a) statistical quantities that are stored verbatim in a committed JSON artefact (bootstrap CI bounds, permutation p-values, wins/losses/ties) are recorded as 'read' with an exact path, per instrument rule 3 ('the value should sit at anchor.path'); only quantities that no artefact stores as a scalar (range minima/maxima across files, cross-CI overlap judgements) take 'recompute-script'. (b) Candidate identifiers such as 'cand 2397', session numbers, dates, commit hashes, and section cross-references are excluded per instrument rule 5. (c) Buffer radii are extracted as physical values where they qualify a reported statistic and are mechanically anchorable. The 12 v1 tests live across three directory families: results/55maps-cross-track-comparison/paired-image-vs-text-high-{20,30,40,50}m/, results/55maps-cross-track-comparison/paired-image-vs-text-min-{20,30,40,50}m/, and results/55maps-text-high-generalisation/paired-vs-min-{20,30,40,50}m/ — no single artefact records the count of tests, the count of contrasts, or the ties range, hence anchor-unknown / recompute-script for those. Note a second candidate family exists at results/55maps-text-min-generalisation/paired-vs-high-{20,30,40,50}m/; the anchors here use the text-high-generalisation family, whose condition labels match the section 5.1 contrast direction (text-HIGH as condition A).
